description: Diagnose and restore the Claude Desktop app when it will not start, crashes, or runs with no visible window. Use for Windows MSIX launch failures, 'Not main instance', stale AppX job containers, NeedsRemediation or 0x80070020 errors. Separates Desktop from the CLI, reads fresh logs, picks a narrow fix and proves a visible working window. Triggers: /claude-repair, Claude Desktop won't open, Claude app crashed.
